Name: Lynn's Bedroom for DGA
Author: LynnNexus
Description:
Well I made couches and chairs... Now I wanted something that matched for my bedroom... So what do we have?
-Single bed
-Double bed
-Benches that fit the end of both the single and double beds
-2 sizes of dresser
-vanity with mirror
-desk
-Mirror for your wall
-Mirror to set on tables
-Night stand/small table

We've got all that in 4 wood colors (walnut, ebony, pine and painted white) and all the fabric colors I had (and have added) for my chairs.  I have no idea if that seems like a lot to other people but HOT DAMN was it a lot for me. 

Now, you might ask: Why aren't there child beds?  Child beds are just single beds designated for children!
And I would answer: Yea, and that sucks.  Why shouldn't the child beds be different? 
So if you're looking at this and pining for some cute beds for your Stardew Little ones... Be patient with me?  I'm probably gonna make a nursery mod in the future (because matching everything!! including cribs!), I tend to make mods as I am going to use them?  and I haven't actually had any kids in stardew yet so that's future me's problem atm.

Requires:
Dynamic Game Assets and it's requirements

Technical notes:
Once you have DGA you can just plunk the unzipped folder in your mods folder and go to town.
You can add and remove this mod whenever, Just remove the items from your save before removing the mod.
This should be compatible with pretty much anything so long as you have DGA.  All items are their own item.  If you have an issue feel free to poke me.

As I said in my chairs thing, I'm willing to take on ideas for other furniture.  I've got the whole nursery idea and thoughts for some windows/walls/floors but I'm not 100% on what I'll be doing with those, I just know that I need different flooring, and walls and I need pretty windows.
